Name: Kore, Father of Shallum
Summary: Father of Shallum the porter, son of Ebiasaph son of Korah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:19: Father of Shallum the porter, son of Ebiasaph son of Korah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Kore in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
